The seat top is a 2-row strip, about the same as the 'seat: band 2' and 'side elevation chair' red references. It is too thin to read as a horizontal sitting surface seen from above, so the drawing is a front elevation, not a three-quarter view.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny side-view chair with only 8 distinct colours, a thin brown silhouette and one or two wood tones. The seat and backrest are flat strips with no grain, no highlight and no per-part shading. The bench reference has a lit top slat, a darker front and a shadow, so it shows about 4-5 steps; the candidate shows only 2-3. The measured facts give 0 tones per tile because the piece is smaller than a tile, so I judged by eye. Next to the bench it looks thinner, flatter and more sticker-like. The measured 0% neutral share supports the tint reading. Overall it is clearly shallower than the references.
